what: EastGroup Properties owns business distribution parks in the American Sun Belt: clusters of smaller warehouses leased to local and regional distributors rather than single huge boxes.
customers: Distributors, logistics firms and light manufacturers in Texas, Florida, Arizona, California and the Southeast.
moat: Multi-tenant parks in infill locations near city centres, where land is scarce and where tenants need to be close to customers for last-mile delivery.
risks: 33 times earnings for a landlord growing rents in the high single digits
A lot of warehouse space was built in the Sun Belt in 2022 and 2023 and is still being absorbed
$1.6B of debt against essentially no cash
opportunities: A 35.7% net margin and $485M of free cash flow on $770M of revenue
Revenue grew from $410M to $721M in four years
Rents on expiring leases are being reset far above the old levels, which lifts income without new building
watch: Releasing spreads on expiring leases and occupancy in the Sun Belt parks.
